summary.text: Scott Jackson is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 111 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Rey Martinez.
An executive who has worked as a director of leadership and professional development, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jackson earned a high school diploma from Cross Keys High School, an associate degree from Gwinnett College, a bachelor's degree from DeVry University and a graduate degree from Southern New Hampshire University, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father and executive with more than 15 years of experience in management, operations and leadership development, including programs supporting people with disabilities and mental health issues.
Jackson won the 2024 Democratic primary for District 111 unopposed and lost the November 2024 general election to Martinez, 61.5 percent to 38.5 percent.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
His 2024 survey answers listed economic development, infrastructure and sustainability, and support for mental health, disabilities and the aging community among his key messages.
